title: Add retry helper and export permission

threads.author: reviewer-a
threads.body: MAX_RETRIES = 3 is too low for our flaky partner API; we see transient 503s that clear on the 4th or 5th try. Please raise this to 5 and make the backoff jittered.

threads.author: reviewer-b
threads.body: canExport should also allow the `analyst` role, they need CSV exports for the quarterly report. Can you add it here?

threads.author: reviewer-a
threads.body: nit: `2 ** attempt` reads oddly next to the multiplication; `Math.pow(2, attempt)` or a named `exponent` would be clearer.
